note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Diversity creates coverage but full-solution interaction erases it (interaction tax); independent generation and repair-focused critique are alternatives

nodes.name: Mixed evidence on interaction
nodes.description: Prior work shows mixed evidence: debate, critique loops and mixture-of-agents report gains, while other work finds multi-agent systems add cost or that independent sampling already captures the benefit.

nodes.name: Model families find different solutions
nodes.description: Different model families (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini) each achieve the best score on at least one of 11 verifier-scored optimization tasks, so they find structurally different solutions.

nodes.name: Same-model teams have zero-score tasks
nodes.description: Every same-model team scores Q=0 on at least one task, whereas a diverse team (Claude+GPT-4o+Gemini) never scores zero on any task, with aggregate Q comparable to the best same-model team.

nodes.name: Diversity coefficient is positive
nodes.description: In a 2x2 factorial (N=120, three tasks), the model-diversity coefficient is +0.188 (CI [+0.073, +0.299], p<0.001) while the synthesis coefficient is near zero.

nodes.name: Full-solution interaction collapses diversity
nodes.description: When agents read each other's complete outputs, their proposals converge within one round: mean pairwise distance between solution representations falls from 0.315 to 0.229.

nodes.name: Interaction tax: same-model gains, diverse-model losses
nodes.description: Chain, MAgICoRe and Debate have positive same-model MIG (+0.051, +0.044, +0.012) but negative diverse-model MIG (-0.024, -0.035, -0.078), with bootstrap P(same>div) of at least 88%.

nodes.name: No configuration beats single-agent baselines
nodes.description: No configuration achieves positive aggregate MEG over single-agent baselines; MoA is the only one whose 95% CI includes zero.

nodes.name: MoA avoids the collapse
nodes.description: MoA, whose proposers never read each other's outputs, keeps positive MIG for same-model and diverse teams (+0.012 to +0.016).

nodes.name: Synthesis copies rather than recombines
nodes.description: On five of seven tasks, synthesis copies the best proposer's output at least 80% of the time instead of combining parts, and on Erdos GPT-4o outputs the identical constant on 100% of seeds (Q=0.710), so interaction converges to that point.

nodes.name: Critique helps only for locatable faults
nodes.description: Critique with diverse models helps when the violated rule is easy to find and fix (Knapsack-50 Debate 2/10 to 10/10 feasibility) but hurts when it is hard to locate (3AP-Free-100: MAgICoRe 6/10 to 3/10, Debate 6/10 to 0/10).

nodes.name: Interaction bandwidth matters more than agent count
nodes.description: Multi-agent performance depends less on the number of agents than on what information they exchange and when; lower-bandwidth signals such as scores, method descriptions or failure causes may preserve independent exploration.

isolated_nodes.name: Diversity theory explains the tax
isolated_nodes.description: Ensemble diversity decomposition says ensemble error equals mean member error minus a diversity term, so when members communicate and converge, diversity shrinks toward zero; the interaction tax is a structural instance.

isolated_nodes.name: Debate regresses once agents read full solutions
isolated_nodes.description: On Erdos, diverse Debate achieves a strong intermediate score at round 2 but regresses at round 3 once agents read each other's full solutions.

isolated_nodes.name: Coverage finding is task-dependent
isolated_nodes.description: Removing Erdos drops the diversity coefficient to +0.014 with a CI crossing zero; the main benchmark uses only five seeds per condition.

isolated_nodes.name: Benchmark design
isolated_nodes.description: Ten configurations (four single-agent baselines and multi-agent workflows) built from Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Flash are tested on 11 verifier-scored optimization tasks with a hidden evaluator for the final artifact.

isolated_nodes.name: Evolutionary methods preserve diversity differently
isolated_nodes.description: FunSearch and AlphaEvolve preserve population diversity through selection pressure rather than agent interaction.

structural_reasoning: Core chain: model diversity gives coverage; full-solution exchange collapses it (interaction tax), MoA-style independence avoids it, and critique effects depend on fault locatability. Supporting setup and caveats isolated.
